articles.title: Crypto IPOs could create massive $1 trillion market amid tokenization wave, Jefferies says
articles.snippet: The Wall Street investment bank expects a wave of crypto and blockchain public listings over the next two years as institutional investors shift their focus from speculative trading to real-world financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Singapore charges former Hodlnaut CEO Zhu Juntao over Terra collapse claims
articles.snippet: Zhu allegedly directed staff to publish false claims that Hodlnaut had no direct exposure to the TerraUSD collapse on Telegram and in customer emails.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX rejects U.K. sanction allegations, says it refused ruble stablecoin listing
articles.snippet: U.K. authorities sanctioned HTX, saying there were "reasonable grounds to suspect" the crypto exchange was helping Russia by cooperating with ruble stablecoin A7A5.

articles.title: Crypto-backed candidates win key Texas primary runoffs
articles.snippet: Crypto PACs threw serious money behind a handful of Texas runoffs, helping oust a senior Democrat and boost Republican hopefuls as lawmakers hammer out new US crypto rules.

articles.title: YouTube Makes AI Content Labels More Prominent as Google Pushes Video Remix Tools
articles.snippet: YouTube says new disclosure tools and automatic AI detection will help viewers more easily identify AI-generated videos.
